blurb: Downtown Joe's is a brewery and restaurant in Napa, California, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a focus on locally sourced ingredients and on-site brewed beers. The venue features live music nearly every night, sports viewings, and festive holiday gatherings. It offers a family-friendly dining experience with a pet-friendly heated patio and a relaxed pub vibe.
